title: 第一卷 第5章 内门师姐的收买第一卷 第6章 大人时代变了
slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
此话一出，蓝裙女子眼前一亮。
“此话当真？！”
“当然。”
叶云点了下头，并不似在开玩笑。
这让蓝裙女子惊喜不已，如果别人说她或许会怀疑。
可这位刚刚拿出无暇品质的升玄丹，或许真有途径搞到圣火丹也说不定！
蓝裙女子立马道：“师姐似乎还在闭关，您看五天后在这见面行吗？”
叶云想了下，后天是外门弟子考核，五天后倒是没什么事了。
“没问题，那就五天后再见。”
在与叶云约定好时间后，蓝裙女子热情地将他给送走了。
毕竟要是事情办成，不仅相当于结识个大客户，还算是便向救了内门师姐的性命！
至于叶云在从店铺离开后，接着去别家买了些东西。
例如凡阶上品身法，剑诀，以及能遮掩气息的隐匿之术，也算基本完善了修行所需之术。
有了这些东西，稍微熟络一下，不出意外，过两日的外门考核几乎就是十拿九稳。
“说起来，这会对战名单应该已经出了吧。”
由于晋级考核是提前报名，上面会在考核前，将对阵名单排出来，这会应该都已经公示了。
但叶云也懒得去看，反正为了留在废丹房，无论对手是谁他都必须要赢！
可叶云才刚回到废丹房，就发现自己的上司，也是管理各部杂役的主管正在等他。
似是由于废丹气息难闻，他始终捏着鼻子，嘴里还在吐槽。

“这破地方，是人待的吗？”
“许师兄，这是什么风，把您给吹来了？”
叶云当即迎了上去，笑着问道。
这杂役主管名叫许鹫，又名老秃鹫，比他早来杂役司几年，除了平时贪一点，其它时候待人行事都还不错。
见到叶云，他捏着鼻子说道。
“叶师弟，明天的晋级考核，你恐怕得弃权了。”
“啊？为什么？”
叶云愣了一下，疑惑问道。
就见许鹫伸出手，从储物袋取出一个布袋递给他，打开一看是上百颗玄晶。
这让叶云更加奇怪，看了他一眼问道。
“师兄？这是何意？”
许鹫也没废话，直言道。
“这是内门的雪岚师姐，托我转交给你的，希望你能在明天的考核中认输。”

As soon as these words came out, the woman in blue dress' eyes lit up.
"Is this true?!"
"Of course."
Ye Yun nodded, not as if he was joking.
This surprised the woman in the blue dress, and she might have been suspicious if others told her.
But this guy who just took out the flawless Shengxuan Pill might actually have a way to get the Holy Fire Pill!
The woman in the blue dress immediately said: "Senior sister seems to be still in retreat. Do you think we can meet here in five days?"
Ye Yun thought for a moment, the day after tomorrow was the outer disciples' assessment, but after five days there was nothing going on.
"No problem, see you in five days."
After agreeing on a time with Ye Yun, the woman in blue skirt enthusiastically sent him away.
After all, if the matter is completed, it will not only be equivalent to meeting a big customer, but also saving the life of the inner sect sister!
As for Ye Yun, after leaving the store, he went to buy some things elsewhere.
For example, the upper-grade body skills, sword techniques, and concealment techniques that can cover the breath can be considered as basically perfecting the techniques required for cultivation.
With these things and a little familiarity, if nothing unexpected happens, the external examination in two days will be almost guaranteed.
"Speaking of which, the list for this match should have been announced."
Since the promotion assessment requires early registration, the team will be ranked before the assessment, and this meeting should have been announced.
But Ye Yun didn't bother to look. Anyway, in order to stay in the useless alchemy room, he had to win no matter who his opponent was!
But as soon as Ye Yun returned to the Waste Pill Room, he found that his boss, who was also the supervisor of the handymen in various departments, was waiting for him.
It seemed that because of the unpleasant smell of the waste pill, he kept pinching his nose and kept complaining.
"Is this wretched place meant for people to live in?"
"Senior Brother Xu, what kind of wind is this that brings you here?"
Ye Yun immediately greeted him and asked with a smile.
This handyman supervisor is named Xu Vulture, also known as Old Vulture. He came to the handyman department a few years earlier than him. Apart from being a bit greedy, he treats others well at other times.
Seeing Ye Yun, he pinched his nose and said.
"Junior Brother Ye, I'm afraid you will have to abstain from the promotion test tomorrow."
"Ah? Why?"
Ye Yun was stunned for a moment and asked doubtfully.
Xu Jiu stretched out his hand, took out a cloth bag from the storage bag and handed it to him. When he opened it, he saw that it contained hundreds of mysterious crystals.
This made Ye Yun even more strange, and he glanced at him and asked.
"Senior brother? What does this mean?"
Xu Jiu didn't talk nonsense and said bluntly.
"This is Senior Sister Xue Lan from the inner sect. She asked me to pass it on to you. I hope you can admit defeat in tomorrow's assessment."
